0.name: Renfe: high speed, long and medium distance

rules.day: The timetable is that of Wednesday 9 December 2026: the first Tuesday, Wednesday or Thursday inside every file, after the day the newest one was written, on which every operator and every Cercanías network runs at least 90% of the trains of its busiest day of the same weekday. Trains running on from the day before are not counted.
rules.router: The shortest journey to any station in the municipality of Madrid over all of the day's departures (profile Connection Scan), with at least 10 minutes to change trains and walks of up to 1.5 km in a straight line between stations at 4.5 km/h. Trains are boarded and left only where the timetable allows it.
rules.access: Each hex adds to the journey of the best station within 30 km of its centre the straight-line distance at 40 km/h, a map convention rather than a driving time. Further away, no value.
rules.trains: A station's trains are the distinct trains that can be boarded there that day; a train the timetable writes several times (once for each stretch where it may be boarded) counts once.
rules.ghost: OpenStreetMap railways are snapped to links between hexes. Each pair of consecutive stops takes the shortest path along them, if it is at most 1.5 times the straight line plus 15 km, and adds its trains to each link. A ghost line is Adif track with no passenger train that day; it may carry freight. Other operators' track without trains is not drawn. Adif's metre-gauge track without trains is not drawn: the Renfe Feve timetable is not in the map.

lens.unit: hours and minutes of timetabled travel
lens.description: The shortest train journey to Madrid on Wednesday 9 December 2026, from the best station within 30 km, plus the way there in a straight line at 40 km/h. It counts every departure of the day, with 10 minutes to change trains and walks of up to 1.5 km between stations. The access speed, the radius and the change time are map conventions, not measured times.
lens.note: Timetable of Wednesday 9 December 2026 (week of 7 to 13 December). Trains of Renfe, Ouigo and Iryo (Iryo's from an unofficial compilation). Left out: FGC, Euskotren, FGV, SFM, metros, trams and buses. It is the published timetable: delays, sold-out trains and later works are not counted. With the lens on, track with trains is drawn thicker the more trains it carries, and Adif track without passenger trains in dashed grey. Adif's metre-gauge track without trains is not drawn: the Renfe Feve timetable is not in the map.
